policy: Only user-facing and relay-facing findings are acted on. Entries below are pattern findings triaged as FALSE POSITIVES with code evidence; static-scan tooling (pre-commit hooks, CI) should treat a hit on file+sink as suppressed instead of blocking.

findings.evidence: The 'exec' the scanner flags is RegExp.prototype.exec on a link-parsing regex, not process execution.
Same RegExp.exec confusion as FP-01; no child_process anywhere in the renderer.
The wrapper calls the LOCAL core over a loopback WebSocket/HTTP bridge; SSRF labels on localhost RPC are by design. Bridge auth hardening tracked in #61.
The flagged parameters are UI strings rendered through the app's escaped templates; no raw HTML interpolation on the flagged paths.

notes: Mimosa's pre-commit hook hard-blocks commits over these findings when its L3 scan manages to run (enforcement is disk-pressure dependent, usually degrading to warn mode scanner_enobufs). No rescan can clear pattern FPs on first-party code — the remedy is consulting this ledger, not rescanning.
